title: Sodium α-ketoglutarate: controlled mouse function and an ADRB2 protein-regulation precedent
recommendation: Retain a substantive preclinical muscle-function reserve tied to the tested sodium preparation. No clinical nomination change or BUBR1-restoration claim.
key_boundary: Complete scientific main and native Figures2–6 reviewed. Both correction texts and corrected primer table read; corrected Figure1 pixels remain unreviewed. Original Figure1 is excluded from visual evidentiary credit.

preparation.mdx_water: α-ketoglutarate sodium, 2% in drinking water; water-only controls.
preparation.duration_conflict: Animals Methods says9weeks; Figure2 legend says8weeks; native body-weight graph extends toweek9.
unknown: Whether2% is weight/volume or another basis
preparation.cell: 2mM AKG for48h in differentiated C2C12; precise AKG form not resolved in these Methods.
preparation.injection: 1g/kg intraperitoneal AKG;3h readout explicitly for inhibitor experiment. Exact injection form not established; do not infer oral equivalence.
preparation.corticosterone: 10µM in cell experiments;50µg/kg in mouse Figure1/3 context. Figure1 injection-to-readout interval not specified in legend.

mdx_experiment.starting_age: Not specified in reviewed mdx description
mdx_experiment.randomization: Groups divided; randomized allocation not expressly described for mdx study.
other_results: Absolute gastrocnemius and soleus weights increased versus untreated mdx.
Fiber-size measure inµm increased; do not relabel as a measured area.
FoxO1/MuRF1/MAFbx-associated protein readouts shifted in the proposed antiatrophy direction.
mdx_experiment.statistics: Mean±SEM; one-way ANOVA followed by Bonferroni post-hoc tests; no exact effect estimates/CIs supplied in text.
limits: Grip is not body-weight-normalized or isolated specific force.
Repeated grip efforts are within animals, not extra animal replicates.
No demonstrated baseline absolute muscle-mass deficit versus WT; hypertrophy is not necessarily restoration of lost mass.
Different WT/mdx strain backgrounds complicate genotype comparisons.
Drug comparison within mdx remains actual controlled function evidence.
No complete normalization, survival, dystrophin rescue or MVA outcome established.
No stated detailed treadmill stopping criterion or dedicated attrition accounting.

actual_compound_results: Increased ADRB2 immunoblot/fluorescence abundance, cAMP and PKA/CREB phosphorylation (4D–K, generallyn=6/group).
Reduced PHD3 protein, without corresponding PHD1/2 changes.
ADRB2_protein_mechanism.stability_interpretation: Supports authors protein-stability model through abundance/ubiquitination and perturbations; no direct ADRB2 half-life or turnover kinetics reported.
ADRB2_protein_mechanism.PHD3_overexpression: Separate genetic perturbation in C2C12 opposes AKG-associated ADRB2 abundance/myotube/protein effects; not genetic rescue of disease.

ICI118551.interpretation: Blockade supports dependence; inhibitor-alone effects and unreported specificity/interaction estimates limit exclusivity.

shADRB2_experiment.population: Forty6-week-old C57BL/6J mice; male per legend
shADRB2_experiment.regimen: Scrambled or shADRB2 lentivirus in gastrocnemius, each with/without2%AKG water for8weeks.
shADRB2_experiment.native_functional_panels: 6H–J: grip and high/slow-speed running improve under scrambled control; AKG comparison after knockdown labelled nonsignificant.
shADRB2_experiment.interpretation: Separate normal-background drug-plus-genetic-perturbation experiment; not mdx-specific mechanism proof. No formal treatment-by-knockdown interaction estimate supplied.

ADRB2_protein_mechanism.AHA_assay_limit: AHA is incorporated metabolic label, not itself a long-lived muscle protein. Methods do not clearly specify a full pulse–chase turnover-rate design. Synthesis/assay contribution cannot be excluded from this readout alone.

corrections.change: Replaces incorrect Figure1A image; authors state results/conclusions unchanged.
corrections.scope_read: Complete notice and corrected Figure1 legend.
corrections.native_access: Official2-page PDF located through web reader; ordinary direct download403 and screenshot wrapper did not expose pixels.
corrections.credit_limit: No original Figure1 visual credit. Functional Figure2 is not the panel identified by the correction; no global validation inferred.

corrections.change: Corrects originalTable1 primer sequences after copy/paste mistake.
corrections.original_table_status: Superseded; original PHD3 andADRB2 duplicated primer pairs must not be used.

harms: No dedicated adverse-event, mortality, cardiac/tumor/reproductive or long-term assessment presented. No specific harm established here; absence of reporting is not safety evidence.
competition: Actual disease-model function and administered-compound protein-regulation evidence merit reserve priority beyond pathway-only hypotheses. Lack of MVA proof is not applied selectively against niacin/arimoclomol, which also lack BUBR1 functional rescue in baseline appraisals. These mouse exposures do not establish clinical superiority over niacin, apitegromab or creatine; no head-to-head ranking or nominee switch.
identity_routing: Use sodium-AKG preparation identity if a future entry is drafted; no generic acid/salt/ester catalog propagation. No ketoglutarate/oxoglutarate main-catalog record found in the checked baseline tables; NIH DSLD has many distinct and shared generic groups.
supplement_scope: No supplementary attachment identified in saved full PMC article; not proof none exists elsewhere.
